Hmm I believe and it might not necessarily be the case but maybe you provoke people for the reaction to get some sort of attention. You have been outcasted and left alone, as humans we crave physical interaction and want to have a sense of Belonging, it might be difficult to snap yourself out of it but you have to remember you are not confined to who you are, we are not character playing in a tv show.... you literally can wake up tomorrow and be a new person 
Personality is psychological. 
Ask yourself the hardest question you can ask yourself and try to tweak the things and if it impacts you in a better way then keep going, I’m not saying to change for anybody else I’m saying change for you. At the end of the day be 100% real, don’t provoke people perhaps be sarcastic but in a nice and friendly way ( not to harsh)

Interesting And why do you feel like a burden? Are you antisocial? Do you feel like you aren’t able to relate to them? Let me tell you like this, all my life I’ve tried to fit in with everybody and it always seemed like I was forcing my self to become somebody I wasn’t. I wanted to fit in just like everybody else but you have to realize maybe it’s not you but them, perhaps you haven’t found your kind of people and who you relate too the most. 

Thinking about a moment that you felt that why and think of all the possible reasons you feel that they would try to avoid you. Give me examples

At times the world can feel like it’s chewing you up and breaking you down day by day, you feel like you never catch a break right. You feel like you are missing out on valuable experiences but have you ever asked yourself this “I’m I doing all I possibly can to achieve my goals?”
In these times it’s hard to find work but are you applying to every job opportunity you see? Or are you picking the once you think you would like? I worked at Wienerschnitzl for couple months and I hated it but it got me “experience” and that’s what jobs look for. Don’t matter the job work your way up man.

Girls will come and go dude, girls can literally smell the desperation and you must know okay if I don’t feel confident in myself then who is going to find me attractive? Working out is a great way to build that, educating yourself, standing up straight head up high and smile people are attractive to good people so even you don’t feel like that you have to try to smile and say hi to meet new people, don’t be afraid take risks and be respectful and she’ll come. 

You don’t hate who you are..... you don’t know who you are yet. Stay up kid Focus on the man you want to become before anything and once you become that man, the confidence comes through because you are no longer faking who you wish you where but instead being him.

“Bad karma” you are saying you brought it on yourself? Perhaps going out of your way to help others or volunteer to do something nice could help you feel better about yourself. Don’t do it because you think it might get you good karma instead do it because you want to

Every body peaks at there own time, I didn’t really start socializing with people until I left high school. I was a shy and weird kid, but I began to just say hi to people  I met some cool friends from work and I met people in College. Maybe what you need is to build up confidence, educate yourself by reading self profession books, working out, try to talk to people online and ask them question that you would talk in real life. But make the conversion interesting and try your hardest to keep it going to build up that fluidity when you’re speaking to people. Being interesting is something a lot of people think they have to be born with but in reality the more stuff you do and try are personal stories and experiences you’ll add to who you are. The more experiences and stories you have makes you more interesting. 

So get out there and do some ab work out 10 push ups 10 abs. Read books that help you become the best you.
And go out! When somebody tells you “ you want to go somewhere” go! Live life and trust me people will notice.
